test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Ram and Shyam start walking from the same place in the opposite direction. If Shyam walks at a speed of 5(1)/(4)km/hr and Ram at a speed of 3 km/hr, then after how much time will they be 44 km apart?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Shyam = 5¹/₄ km/hr

Speed of Ram = 3 km/hr

Distance apart = 44 km

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed = Speed of Shyam + Speed of Ram

Relative Speed = 5¹/₄ + 3

Relative Speed = 21/4 + 3

Relative Speed = 21/4 + 12/4

Relative Speed = 33/4 km/hr

Time = 44 / (33/4)

⇒ Time = 44 × 4 / 33

⇒ Time = 176 / 33

⇒ Time = 5¹¹/₃₃

⇒ Time = 5¹/₃ hours

⇒ Time = 5 hours 20 minutes

**The correct answer is option 4.**
